parts.html: The “Furniture” interior design package — €35–45/m²

DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) offers a dedicated “Furniture” design package for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces where the main finishing work has already been completed and custom furniture now needs to be properly designed, manufactured, and installed.
The package gives you not only a visual concept of the future interior but also a complete set of furniture drawings — the technical specification needed to manufacture bespoke cabinet furniture.

It is the optimal solution if the space is already ready to be furnished and you need to plan the furniture arrangement, storage systems, kitchen, wardrobes, walk-in closets, and other built-in furniture.
What’s included in the “Furniture” package
1. Set of drawings
Includes:
— a measured floor plan of the space;
— a furniture layout plan.
The layout makes it possible to determine furniture placement in advance and organize the space around the room’s dimensions, circulation paths, ergonomics, and functional requirements.
2. 3D visualization of every room
Photorealistic 3D visualizations are created for each room, letting you see the future interior and furniture before production even begins.
The package price includes one full round of revisions to the developed concept.
3. Development of furniture drawings
Once the design is approved, a complete set of furniture drawings is prepared — the technical specification for manufacturing the custom furniture.
The dimensions, configuration, interior fittings, and main structural solutions of the bespoke furniture are worked out in detail.
As a result, you receive a project from which the furniture can go straight into production.
What furniture can be designed
As part of the project, we can design bespoke cabinet furniture for all the main rooms:
— kitchens with built-in appliances;
— wardrobes and built-in storage systems;
— walk-in closets;
— bedroom furniture;
— living room furniture;
— TV areas and wall panels;
— entrance hall furniture;
— bathroom furniture;
— workspaces and home offices;
— furniture for commercial spaces.
Each solution is designed individually to fit the dimensions of the specific room, the architecture of the space, and the client’s requirements.
Custom furniture manufacturing
Once the design stage is complete, DUMSKAYA DESIGN can arrange for the furniture to be manufactured according to the drawings developed.
This lets you go through the entire process within a single project: from measurements, layout, and 3D visualization to working furniture drawings, manufacturing, delivery, and installation.
Custom manufacturing is especially important for kitchens, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets, and other structures where the available space needs to be used as efficiently as possible.
The design takes into account the room’s dimensions, the location of utilities and built-in appliances, the required storage capacity, ergonomics, and the overall style of the interior.
Who the “Furniture” package is for
The package is ideal if:
— your apartment or house already has its finishes in place;
— the property was purchased with a developer’s finish;
— no major renovation is required;
— the apartment or house needs to be fully furnished;
— you need a kitchen and built-in furniture made to custom dimensions;
— you want a unified furniture design for all rooms;
— you need professional drawings for production.
This way, you don’t need to order a full design project with an extensive set of construction documentation if the main renovation work has already been done.
“Furniture” package pricing: €35–45/m²
Minimum package price: €2,000.
The final cost depends on the floor area of the property, the number of rooms, the amount of furniture to be designed, and the complexity of the project.
What you get

As a result, you receive an approved furnishing concept for the space, furniture layout plans, photorealistic 3D visualizations, and a complete set of furniture drawings for manufacturing your custom furniture.
If you also order manufacturing, the project can be delivered end to end — including production, delivery, and installation of the designed furniture.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) — interior design and bespoke furniture, conceived as one cohesive whole.
